## RK

1. ### 
    
    risk
    
    _—_ 2026-07-29, 12:16
    
    The experience is already interesting . There's an inherent tension in me wanting to be clever with my choice of 5 letter words over the coming days because understanding that they'll each form a word instrument (very cool as a conceptual "object") with distinctive sound is potentially at odds with what the words will semantically mean together (and how those word instruments will additively sound together in relation to the semantic meaning). On seeing that the words would likely be laid out inside the circle in stacked order I immediately wanted to express a 5 (5 letter) word idea. My initial word "house" was influenced by the Uketsu book within line of sight yesterday - _Strange Houses_, but has ramifications on the rest of my words. Current plan: HOUSE DEATH FORMS FRESH GHOST. But I'm already suspecting that me wanting to prefigure that meaning gets in the way of semantic-sound pairing. Or maybe not - maybe the brain will want to hear a pairing and so it will.
